role: worktree pool every crewmate spawn leases from
consequence: critical: if it breaks or changes contract, the fleet cannot dispatch at all

upstream.baseRationale: v2.0.0 is the version actually running the captain's fleet, not upstream head (v2.1.0). A fold exists to stop the ground moving; adopting an unvalidated newer release at the moment of folding imports a change nothing here has tested. The v2.0.0..v2.1.0 delta becomes the first triage decision instead, which is the divergence machinery working as intended.
upstream.license: see upstream LICENSE; retained in the seed tree

ours.status: PROPOSED - not created; repository creation is the captain's outward-facing call

build.note: upstream Makefile sets -X main.version; an unset symbol yields a Go pseudo-version, which is why identity must not rest on the version string

install.rationale: matches the GRyndStone/no-mistakes precedent; deliberately NOT an npm global prefix
